mapper.select: SELECT MU.NICKNAME, MU.PROFILE_IMG, MU.INTRODUCE, MU.TEMPERATURE, U.NAME, U.EMAIL, U.LOGIN_ID, U.OAUTH_PROVIDER FROM MY_USER_PAGE MU JOIN USERS U ON MU.USER_NO = U.USER_NO WHERE MU.USER_NO = #{userNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MY_USER_PAGE (USER_NO, PROFILE_IMG, INTRODUCE, TEMPERATURE, NICKNAME) VALUES (#{userId}, DEFAULT, DEFAULT, DEFAULT, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND TRADE_STATUS = 'SALE' AND IS_DELETED = 'N') AS "saleCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND TRADE_STATUS = 'SOLD' AND IS_DELETED = 'N') AS "tradeCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM CR WHERE (CR.BUYER_NO = #{userNo} OR CR.SELLER_NO = #{userNo}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CHAT_MESSAGE CM WHERE CM.ROOM_ID = CR.ROOM_ID)) AS "chatCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND IS_READ = 'N') AS "unreadNoti", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW WHERE REVIEWEE_NO = #{userNo}) AS "reviewCount", 0 AS "totalViews" FROM DUAL

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID AS "productId", P.PRODUCT_TITLE AS "title", P.PRODUCT_PRICE AS "price", P.TRADE_STATUS AS "status", PF.FILE_PATH AS "imgFile" FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE PF ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PF.PRODUCT_ID AND PF.IS_MAIN = 1 WHERE P.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND P.IS_DELETED = 'N' ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3
